Lua 5.4.9, the official source from https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz (SHA-256 2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6, as listed on lua.org).
Unmodified. Left out on purpose: lua.c, luac.c (the programs), liolib.c, loslib.c, loadlib.c, ldblib.c, linit.c (file, OS, module-loading and debug libraries:
scripts in Eye of SaurCom run in a sandbox, see core/src/automation/script.cpp and docs/automations.md).
